instruction: Candid cinematic full shot of a cozy bedroom. On the left, the barefoot elderly woman with glasses (R2) in a white shirt and light trousers dances with her arms raised, smiling. On the right, the elderly bald man (R1) in a striped shirt and khaki pants faces her, reaching out to hold her hand. They dance on a dark patterned rug with a houseplant and armchair visible on the left. Warm, soft indoor lighting illuminates the room.
elements: R1 is the elderly bald man facing R2 and reaching out to hold her hand
R2 is the barefoot elderly woman with glasses dancing with her arms raised
R1 plays the hand-reaching dance partner role while R2 plays the raised-arms dance partner role
R1 and R2 are dancing together in a bedroom
A dark patterned rug is under the dancing pair
The room has warm, soft indoor lighting

questions.q: Is R1 the person reaching out to hold R2's hand, rather than R2 being the person reaching out to hold R1's hand?
questions.element: R1 reaches out to hold R2's hand

questions.q: Is R2 the person dancing with her arms raised while R1 faces her, rather than R1 being the one dancing with raised arms?
questions.element: R2 dances with arms raised while R1 faces her

questions.q: Does R1 play the hand-taking dance partner role toward R2, rather than R2 taking that role toward R1?
questions.element: R1 has the active hand-reaching role in the dance
